name: recipes
description: Plugins for the recipes corpus. Hosted in the app repo itself, so a plugin versions in lockstep with the binary it drives.

plugins.name: recipes-enrich
plugins.description: The corpus enrichment worker: fixed pull -> read -> push loops that read a recipe's ingredient lines into structured measures, its method into a step DAG, the equipment it requires, and the energy density of each food it uses — using recipe-backend as its only I/O.

plugins.name: recipes-audit
plugins.description: The judgement half of this repo's gates (#176), for defects that are type-correct, lint-clean, tested and green and still describe something untrue: `audit-change` reviews a diff against its claimed intent and against the tree that moved under it, `audit-corpus` measures the tree against the live corpus. Anything mechanical enough to be a gate is one already, in CI.
